terms.definition: A large unstable nucleus (uranium or plutonium) absorbs a neutron and splits into two smaller nuclei, releasing two or three neutrons, gamma rays and energy.
The neutrons released go on to cause further fissions.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Control rods absorb neutrons to control it.

terms.definition: Two light nuclei join to form a heavier nucleus; some mass is converted to energy.
